# SC Precision Deburring

SC Precision Deburring (legal name SC Deburring LLC) is a deburring and finishing shop in Pacoima, California.
We deburr and finish already-machined parts for aerospace, defense, and medical machine shops across Southern California.
We are the overflow deburring bench: shops send us the finishing their own bench can't get to, so jobs don't slip and they don't have to hire.

Services: hand deburring, microscope deburring, flash and heavy burr grinding, and edge finishing / edge break.
Materials: titanium through aluminum, including stainless steel and Inconel.
Typical parts: manifolds, valve bodies, hydraulic fittings, housings, and cross-drilled parts.

Quotes are returned the same day.
We pick up and deliver across Southern California.
New customers can send a small first lot and see the work before committing to anything.

Address: 12734 Branford St STE 17, Pacoima, CA 91331
Phone: (818) 389-4234
Website: https://scprecisiondeburring.com/
